user_request: Recover biologically grounded, spatially testable hypotheses under a withheld-background protocol using library/datasets/dataset.h5ad, then execute test plans and classify hypotheses as SUPPORTED / REFINE / DROPPED.

provenance.justification: The plan is a direct adaptation of the hypothesis_recovery_withheld template: Step 1 corresponds to dataset inventory and background ingestion; Step 2 implements the exploratory analysis phase, explicitly allowing the recruiter to consider cellvoyager_agent and to log its rationale and suggestions; Steps 3–5 map to hypothesis drafting, critic review, and finalization with required quality scores and brief; Step 6 implements the Coding/Reporter testing phase to produce test_results_phase3.json and update hypothesis_brief.md. PDF Reader and gold_claims access remain excluded throughout, as required by the template and user protocol.

steps.title: Ingest background and inventory dataset
steps.description: Read ONLY the limited background from outputs/briefs/paper_summary.txt and load the full AnnData from library/datasets/dataset.h5ad (no subsampling). Generate a data inventory summarizing dimensions, modalities, key .obs/.var annotations, and spatial metadata, and initialize the exploration log with dataset-level notes under the withheld-background constraints.
steps.reasoning: A structured overview of the data and allowed background is necessary to ground all later exploration and hypotheses while respecting the protocol (no PDF access, no gold_claims, no paper findings). This step creates the canonical inventory and log scaffold used by subsequent agents.
steps.assignment_rationale: This step requires reading a brief text file, loading the full AnnData object, and programmatically summarizing its structure; no specialist agent is tailored to dataset inventory, so the general-purpose coding_agent is the right choice for implementing these data-handling and reporting tasks.

steps.title: Run spatial exploratory analysis
steps.description: Perform rich exploratory analysis on the full dataset: QC summaries, embeddings, clustering, cell-type/region distributions (using existing annotations only), spatial maps, neighborhood enrichment, and basic differential expression or marker discovery for salient regions/cell states. Log concrete OBSERVATION entries (e.g., OBSERVATION_001, OBSERVATION_002) with pointers to supporting tables/figures in hypotheses/exploration_log.md. The recruiter SHOULD consider assigning cellvoyager_agent for an autonomous exploratory pass on the same .h5ad + background; if used, its suggestions are saved as hypotheses/cellvoyager_suggestions.json and referenced as OBSERVATION_CV entries in the exploration log, along with a brief note explaining why CellVoyager was or was not used.
steps.reasoning: Hypotheses must be grounded in empirical patterns observed directly in the dataset under the limited background. Combining TissueAgent-style exploration with potential CellVoyager autonomous analysis broadens the search for interesting spatial phenomena while maintaining a transparent trail of observations.
steps.assignment_rationale: This step is a broad, hypothesis-agnostic exploratory analysis of a spatial/single-cell AnnData under limited background, which matches the core design of cellvoyager_agent_agent (autonomous exploratory analysis with iterative figure generation and hypothesis suggestions); its outputs can be serialized into the required exploration_log, plots, marker tables, and cellvoyager_suggestions.json, and this explicitly satisfies the protocol’s recommendation to use CellVoyager for the exploratory pass.

steps.title: Draft observation-grounded hypotheses
steps.description: Using the OBSERVATION entries from exploration_log.md (and, if present, hypotheses/cellvoyager_suggestions.json), generate approximately three biologically plausible, spatially testable hypotheses. Each hypothesis must (i) clearly state the biological/spatial pattern, (ii) explicitly reference the supporting OBSERVATION ids, (iii) outline a falsifiable test_plan that can be executed on library/datasets/dataset.h5ad, and (iv) avoid any dependence on withheld paper findings. Store these as drafts in hypotheses/hypotheses_draft.json with preliminary metadata and structured test_plan fields.
steps.reasoning: This step translates raw exploratory observations into candidate hypotheses that are explicit, testable, and properly linked back to specific dataset evidence while remaining independent of any external gold claims.
steps.assignment_rationale: Transforming structured OBSERVATION entries (and optional CellVoyager suggestions) into a small set of biologically plausible, spatially testable hypotheses with explicit test plans is exactly the purpose of hypothesis_agent, which is specialized for generating novel, testable hypotheses from existing evidence.

steps.title: Critically review and score hypotheses
steps.description: A Critic Agent reviews each draft hypothesis for biological plausibility, non-circular logic, clarity, and testability. For every hypothesis, assign structured quality scores for derivable, novel, feasible, specific, and falsifiable dimensions, plus an overall robustness score and free-text critique. Save the review as hypotheses/pre_review_criticism.json and, if helpful, annotate hypotheses_draft.json with referenced critique ids.
steps.reasoning: Independent critique and scoring enforce rigor, helping to filter out vague or weak hypotheses and ensuring that only sufficiently strong and testable ideas move forward to the finalized set and testing phase.
steps.assignment_rationale: This step calls for independent critical review and multi-dimensional quality scoring of drafted hypotheses, which falls squarely within critic_agent’s remit to assess hypotheses for plausibility, non-circularity, and testability and to produce structured critiques.

steps.title: Finalize hypotheses and prepare brief
steps.description: Revise the draft hypotheses using the critic’s feedback, adjusting statements and test_plans to improve specificity, feasibility, and falsifiability while preserving links to underlying OBSERVATION ids. Produce the final hypotheses/hypotheses.json where each hypothesis includes: statement, rationale, grounded_in observations, detailed test_plan, and the full set of quality_scores (derivable, novel, feasible, specific, falsifiable, robustness). Initialize a status field (e.g., PENDING_TEST) for each. In parallel, create a human-readable hypotheses/hypothesis_brief.md that narratively summarizes each finalized hypothesis and its planned tests without referencing any withheld paper results.
steps.reasoning: This consolidates the vetted hypotheses into a stable, machine- and human-readable specification that downstream testing can follow, and ensures that required quality scores are embedded in the final hypotheses.json.
steps.assignment_rationale: Revising hypotheses in light of critique, refining their statements and test plans, and producing a finalized hypotheses.json plus a narrative hypothesis_brief.md builds directly on hypothesis_agent’s strength in constructing clear, testable hypotheses and associated rationale, making it the best fit for consolidation and documentation of the vetted hypothesis set.

steps.title: Execute test plans and classify hypotheses
steps.description: Execute the predefined test_plan for each hypothesis directly on the full library/datasets/dataset.h5ad (no subsampling), using appropriate spatial and transcriptomic analyses (e.g., spatial co-localization, regional enrichment, neighborhood interactions, differential expression along gradients). For each hypothesis, compute the planned metrics and apply the pre-specified decision criteria to assign a final status: SUPPORTED, REFINE, or DROPPED. Record quantitative results, key plots, and per-hypothesis narrowing_notes in hypotheses/test_results_phase3.json, and update hypotheses/hypothesis_brief.md with a concise summary of outcomes and main supporting/refuting evidence, still without invoking any withheld paper findings.
steps.reasoning: Running the tests and mapping each hypothesis to a concrete outcome completes the hypothesis-recovery loop, enabling objective evaluation of how well the recovered hypotheses are supported by the dataset under the withheld-background constraints.
steps.assignment_rationale: Executing the concrete test plans on the AnnData—running spatial statistics, differential expression, and other analyses, then assigning SUPPORTED/REFINE/DROPPED statuses—requires flexible coding and spatial transcriptomics analysis capabilities; no more specialized agent is tailored to this generic testing stage, so coding_agent is the appropriate general-purpose engine for implementing and quantifying these tests.
